## Finding

This finding file has no YAML frontmatter at all — it cannot be consumed as a
finding. G1.0 must flag it instead of letting it vanish silently.

## Impact

Without the parse guard, this file would disappear from the grader report
without any trace.

## Remediation

Add the required frontmatter block (id, schema_version, title, category,
severity, cwe, status, confidence).
